title: Predictive but Not Plannable: RC-aux for Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.07278v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A latent world model may achieve accurate short-horizon prediction while still inducing a latent space that is poorly aligned with planning. A key issue is spatiotemporal mismatch: these models are often trained with local predictive supervision, but deployed for long-horizon goal-directed search in latent spaces where Euclidean distance may not reflect what is reachable within a finite action budget. We present the Reachability-Correction auxiliary objective (RC-aux), a lightweight correction for this mismatch in reconstruction-free latent world models. RC-aux keeps the world-model backbone unchanged and adds planning-aligned supervision along two axes. Along the time axis, multi-horizon open-loop prediction trains the model beyond one-step consistency. translated_title: 可预测但不可规划：用于潜在世界模型的 RC-aux 方法
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型可能实现准确的短时程预测，但其诱导出的潜在空间却可能与规划目标 poorly 对齐。一个关键问题是时空不匹配：这类模型通常在局部预测监督下训练，但部署时却要在潜在空间中进行长时程目标导向搜索，而潜在空间中的欧氏距离未必能反映在有限动作预算内哪些状态是可达的。我们提出了可达性校正辅助目标，这是针对无重构潜在世界模型中该不匹配问题的一种轻量级校正方法。RC-aux 保持世界模型骨干网络不变，并沿两个维度引入与规划对齐的监督：在时间轴上，多时程开环预测使模型训练超越单步一致性；在空间轴上，基于动作预算条件的可达性监督结合时间硬负样本，促使潜在空间区分最终可达与不可达的状态。
tldr: 该论文提出 RC-aux 这一轻量级辅助目标，通过多时程开环预测和基于动作预算的可达性监督来校正潜在世界模型的时空不匹配问题，使潜在空间更好地与规划任务对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RC-aux, a lightweight auxiliary objective that corrects the spatiotemporal mismatch in latent world models through multi-horizon open-loop prediction and budget-conditioned reachability supervision, thereby aligning the latent space with planning.
